name: k-plus-one
text: A draft of k tokens adds one pending input token, so the target sees k + 1.

name: ratio-meaning
text: The last column is a forward-cost ratio, not a decoding speedup.

name: verification-table
preview: Draft length k | Input tokens per forward | Forward time (ms) | Time / ordinary step

text:
English
An ordinary step takes 18.90 milliseconds on our chosen historical scale. With k draft tokens, one target forward receives k plus one input tokens. The other rows use assumed cost ratios. They explain the cost model and are not new measurements. The last column compares forward costs, not decoding speed.

中文
这里以历史记录中的普通单步18.90毫秒作为说明标尺。草稿有k个token时，一次目标前向处理k加1个输入token。其余行由假设成本比例换算，用来解释成本模型，不是新测量。最后一列比较的是前向成本，不是解码加速比。

Sources and status
Baseline scale selected by the user: 18.90 ms. The archived calibration gives 18.900229 ms and belongs to the withdrawn October local study. It is a historical illustrative reference, not reinstated benchmark evidence. Ratios 1.10/1.22/1.48/2.05 and lookup ratio .02 are from the existing illustrative_placeholders.json, not measured V(k). No new inference, API calibration or controller experiment was run. Full-precision inputs are retained in cost_example.json.
Archived record: benches/agent_study_20261021_main/calibration.json. Assumed ratios: projects/siliconllm_2026_11_11_predefense/sources/illustrative_placeholders.json. Historical measured V values in that archive are 19.53/24.60/36.78/43.08 ms, not the illustrated values. They are not substituted into current benchmark claims.

name: title
text: Expected Recovery Cost R(k)

name: status
text: REPLAY PATH EXAMPLE

name: footnote
text: Assumed replay cost. A native trim path requires its own cache-handling cost.

name: rejection-example
text: Draft A B C D: accept A and B, reject C.

name: restore
text: Restore the pre-verification KV cache, then process x, A and B.

name: single-rejection-cost
text: This rejection: 3 × 18.90 = 56.70 ms of replay forwards.

name: expected-cost
text: With assumed p = 0.98 and k = 8: R(8) ≈ 12.39 ms per round.

name: expectation-explained
text: R(k) averages all rejection positions, with zero replay for full acceptance.

name: next-input
text: Z is the next normal input. Its next forward is not another replay step.

English
This example uses the replay path. After rejection, we restore the earlier cache. Input x predicts A, input A predicts B, and input B predicts Z. That is three ordinary forwards, estimated at 56.70 milliseconds. R(k) is different: it averages the replay cost across possible rejection positions. For assumed p of 0.98 and k of eight, it is about 12.39 milliseconds per round. Full acceptance adds no replay in this example. A trim path needs a different recovery model.

中文
这个例子对应replay路径。发生拒绝后，先恢复验证前的缓存。输入x预测A，输入A预测B，输入B预测Z，共三次普通前向，按56.70毫秒估算。R(k)不是这一次拒绝的耗时，而是对各个拒绝位置的重放开销加权后的每轮期望值。假设p为0.98、k为8时，约为每轮12.39毫秒。这个算例中，全接受不增加重放。如果使用trim，就需要改用实际缓存裁剪的成本模型。

Assumptions and source
Baseline scale selected by the user: 18.90 ms. The archived calibration gives 18.900229 ms and belongs to the withdrawn October local study. It is a historical illustrative reference, not reinstated benchmark evidence. Ratios 1.10/1.22/1.48/2.05 and lookup ratio .02 are from the existing illustrative_placeholders.json, not measured V(k). No new inference, API calibration or controller experiment was run. Full-precision inputs are retained in cost_example.json.
R(k) = T_step * sum((j+1)*p**j*(1-p), j=0..k-1). This assumes constant independent match probability, no EOS/budget truncation, j+1 replay forwards on rejection and no replay on full acceptance. Snapshot/restore overhead and other missing costs need separate accounting. The four symbolic tokens illustrate j=2; the separate expected-value calculation uses k=8. This is not a claim that mlx-lm native trimming replays an accepted prefix.

name: title
text: Time per Output Token C(k)

name: status
text: ILLUSTRATIVE REPLAY SCORE, NOT A MEASURED CONTROLLER RESULT

name: footnote
text: The table uses unrounded inputs. Displayed values are rounded. The minimum is specific to these assumptions.

name: winner
text: k = 8 has the lowest score in this example.

name: score-table
preview: k | V(k) (ms) | L (ms) | R(k) (ms) | G(k) (tokens) | C(k) (ms/token)

text:
English
We add verification time, lookup time and expected replay time. We divide this by the expected number of output tokens. For k of eight, the score is about 4.90 milliseconds per token. For sixteen, it is about 5.59. Eight has the lowest score in this example and passes the five-percent margin against the ordinary reference. This explains the decision rule. It is not a measured speedup or a decision observed in the API pilot.

中文
先把验证、查找和预期重放耗时相加，再除以预计输出token数。k为8时，分数约为每token 4.90毫秒；k为16时约为5.59。这个算例中，8的分数最低，也满足相对普通基线预留5%收益的条件。这里说明的是选择规则，不是测出来的加速比，也不是API pilot中实际观察到的动态决策。

Calculation and status
Baseline scale selected by the user: 18.90 ms. The archived calibration gives 18.900229 ms and belongs to the withdrawn October local study. It is a historical illustrative reference, not reinstated benchmark evidence. Ratios 1.10/1.22/1.48/2.05 and lookup ratio .02 are from the existing illustrative_placeholders.json, not measured V(k). No new inference, API calibration or controller experiment was run. Full-precision inputs are retained in cost_example.json.
G(k)=1+sum(p**j,j=1..k). L=.378 ms. k=0 is the separate ordinary reference without drafting lookup/replay. R(8)=12.393574645846634; G(8)=8.312611893492505; C(8)=4.901416686822896; C(16)=5.590905260792209. C(8) < .95*18.90 ms. The score does not include every possible policy/cache overhead and is not a calibrated native trim model.
